summary: ORCA three-class annotation contract: carcinoma, heterogeneous non-carcinoma tissue, and immutable non-tissue fragments.

annotation_traits: non-tissue can occur as fragmented holes or islands inside a patch
semantic_limitations: Other tissue is mixed non-carcinoma tissue and must not be interpreted as pure stroma, immune, mucosa, muscle, salivary gland, vessel, or normal epithelium.
ORCA does not encode a reason for non-tissue fragmentation; every zero pixel remains protected.

rules.claim: Treat Other tissue only as ORCA non-carcinoma tissue; do not infer a histologic subtype that the mask does not encode.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A separately versioned annotation source may add a reviewed tissue subtype without changing the ORCA mask.
counterexamples: Calling all gray pixels stroma and allowing a stroma-specific primitive.
Treating muscle or salivary tissue within Other tissue as interchangeable with desmoplastic stroma.
expected_morphology: A candidate follows a visible carcinoma/non-carcinoma interface whose H&E context supports the requested direction.
forbidden_morphology: An edit justified only by the gray class color without H&E compatibility.
known_limitations: The public class contract does not subdivide non-carcinoma tissue.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound background_seed_protection execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: Fragmentation thresholds must be measured from the mounted dataset; the invariant itself does not depend on a threshold.

rules.claim: Start burden edits only from an existing carcinoma/non-carcinoma-tissue interface and keep the entire edit within the connected tissue support on the selected side.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
counterexamples: Starting tumor growth from an isolated point inside gray tissue.
Selecting a black/gray edge as if it were a carcinoma interface.
expected_morphology: The changed band remains attached to one selected carcinoma boundary segment.
forbidden_morphology: Remote islands or edits initiated from non-tissue boundaries.
known_limitations: H&E artifact recognition requires multimodal review.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound edited_label_topology execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: Topology-changing instructions are outside the v1 primitive set.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound profile_required_provenance execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: The repository has not yet mounted a complete immutable ORCA evidence manifest.
